issues.description: The problem statement uses a snake_case method name `get_total_number_of_students()` (problem_statement.md: line 40), while the template and solution use the Java-style camelCase name `getTotalNumberOfStudents()` (template TODO comment and solution implementation). This mismatch can confuse students about the exact method name to implement in Java.
issues.suggestedFix: Update the problem statement to use the camelCase method name `getTotalNumberOfStudents()` to match the UML, template TODOs, and solution implementation (or explicitly state the language-specific naming convention). This removes ambiguity for students implementing the Java method.
